_readme: Stallion's gate invocations, declared ONCE. Each gate names the invocation text and the transports that must carry it; tools/gate-registry.mjs greps the real transport files for both directions of drift — a declared gate missing from a transport, and a transport carrying an invocation the registry does not declare (a shadow gate). Vendors: this is the stallion seed; add your own gates and transports honestly.

gates.why: refuses code staged while no task is in flight — the earliest transport, one action from the mistake
the footer must name an in-flight task whose declared scope covers the staged code; CI's probe re-proves it refuses

every code commit in the push range carries an authorizing task record — the control clones cannot opt out of; the battery transport is the package.json `task-coverage` alias, a bare runnable spelling of the same command
the gate for the gate: an unwired clone refuses to push until it is wired
the whole battery — every self-testing tool in tools/ — on every push
the census: every tracked source file seen by a declared gate
the dead-wiring sweep: contract members need producer and consumer
named prose claims re-proved against code evidence, bidirectionally
remote command strings must not expand where they are built
anti-bug-pinning over the real tools corpus
the overdue clock: an OPEN debt row past budget fails the build
a bare commit on a detached HEAD refuses loudly

the vendoring lineage gate: in a vendored tree the committed VENDOR manifest is law — an undeclared, patched, or deleted vendored file and a missing mapped doc each refuse with a re-vendor remedy; upstream mode keeps stallion itself from ever carrying a forged manifest
every registered guard proven to reach a newly-added file in its corpus
the task lifecycle state machine; battery alias + CI's lifecycle smokes drive it end to end
the eight-lane pass machinery; battery alias + CI's concurrent-record smokes
jj workspace drafting law; battery alias
the intervention gate (refuse at the act); battery alias
